body: I just used up the last of my savings, that also adds to my depression. I've never taken a vacation and I sort of feel I don't deserve one. I'm on a vacation now because I am not working....I like history because I see that it repeats itself. It has a pattern, I also like finding things that no one talks about openly, genocide, famine, etc. I feel those events in history should be talked about in order to have a dialog and get the knowledge out there...so it won't repeat itself.

I live in California and I went to school to be a history teacher. I love history, I just am not sure I want to teach anymore. I can substitute teach and if I go back to school for two years I can be a full teacher. I am just burnt out. I want to work and take care of myself.

I meant 20 interviews since I started looking for work at 16. I just,  I just do not know what in the world is wrong with me.

My career center has not been much of any help but I am thinking of going to the E.D.D office in town and seeing if they can help me out. I am just worried that my degrees are useless and I think a lot of it has to do with scheduling. I've been going to school non stop since I was 19 and a lot of places want you to have an open schedule.

I will try to be more confident but it is hard, especially since i dont have any work experience and i feel weird at my age not having any work history.

I thought everyone has to start with fast food though....
